<STBG 5,1><BGM 0,0,506><MWT 2>Suddenly appearing in the Fractured Isles,
<COL C70101FF>≪It≫</COL> is the endpoint where
<COL C70101FF>≪Wandering Isle Fragments≫</COL> gather―

<MWT 2>If you think desert, it becomes seaside;
if a snow mountain, it becomes a volcano.

<MWT 2>Amid ceaseless storm, thunder and eruption,
it changes form and environment moment by
moment, bewildering explorers.

<MWT 2>The guild unravelled the Isles' history
and reached a certain finding.

<MWT 2>...It was the legend of
<COL C70101FF>the island that changes form</COL>.
<STBG 3,1><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CHAR 5,1,25,0,0><MWT 0><TALK 5><NAME 33><CV 23,26>I will... show you the way.

A form like a phantom...
That island's name is <COL C70101FF>≪Phantom Deep Realm≫</COL>.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,7><CV 1,39><COL C70101FF><COL C70101FF>The environment changes dizzyingly</COL>...
Can we investigate safely and return...?
<TALK 5><NAME 31><MWT 3><BGM 0,0,503><CV 21,2><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1><CHAR 5,0,25,0,1>Wait just a miiiinute!!!!
<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CHAR 5,4,25,0,0><CHAR 5,5,23,0,0><MWT 0><CV 21,27>Ah... good, I made it in time.

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,2><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,28>Amenoma! In such a hurry...
what are those yellow ore and the liquid
you're carrying...?

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 31><CV 21,3><ITEM DEEP_FUEL_00002,1,1>This yellow liquid is <COL C70101FF>≪Exploration Fuel≫</COL>.
By reacting to the ore and emitting a
wavelength, it grasps our current position.

So place a <COL C70101FF>flag with the ore</COL>
at good stopping points, and set
<COL C70101FF>markers</COL> so others don't get lost.

<CHAR 1,0,1,2,4><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,12>I see... with the marker flags and this
Exploration Fuel, we can investigate the
Phantom Deep Realm without getting lost!

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CHAR 5,0,23,0,5><TALK 5><NAME 31><CV 21,1><ITEM 0,1,0>But I can only make a little at a time,
so wait until the fuel builds up.
...Sorry 'bout that.

<CHAR 5,0,23,0,0><ITEM AD_ARM724,1,1>And I made gear like this.
Based on that ore, it's
<COL C70101FF>specially made for the Deep Realm</COL>!

<CHAR 5,0,23,0,4><ITEM 0,1,0><ITEM EVENTPOINTDEEP0001,1,1><CV 21,3>Also, the guild is running a
<COL C70101FF>≪Lottery≫</COL> where you trade
exploration info and rewards!

<CHAR 5,0,23,0,0><CHAR 1,0,1,2,4><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,54><ITEM 0,1,0>Suddenly a giant island appeared, and
though I was startled it feels like a
festival — I think my tension eased.

<CHAR 1,0,1,2,0><CHAR 5,4,23,0,0><CHAR 5,5,25,0,7><TALK 5><NAME 33><CV 23,23>Truly...
the guild's people are resilient...

<MWT 3><CV 21,1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1><CHAR 5,0,25,0,1><COL C70101FF>Don't forget to peek at
<COL C70101FF>Exploration Navi</COL> too!!!!

<MWT 0><CHAR 1,0,1,0,2><CHAR 5,0,25,0,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,90>Eh... what, what? <COL C70101FF>Exploration Navi</COL>
has <COL C70101FF>lavish items</COL> needed for
exploring... piled in, that's what it said?
<CHAR 1,0,1,1,5><CV 1,60>Truly... how reassuring.

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 33><CV 23,45>Then let us head out... to the
<COL C70101FF>≪Phantom Deep Realm≫</COL>.
<CLS>
